metadata.title: Rego Policy Libraries — cfr_part_11 (FDA 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures)

groups.title: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures

controls.title: System not validated to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance, and the ability to discern invalid or altered records

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System not validated to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance, and the ability to discern invalid or altered records

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Validation not repeated after changes that affect electronic records or signatures, so consistent intended performance is not shown (supporting check)

controls.title: System cannot generate accurate and complete copies of records in human readable form suitable for inspection, review, and copying by the agency

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System cannot generate accurate and complete copies of records in human readable form suitable for inspection, review, and copying by the agency

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: System cannot generate accurate and complete copies of records in electronic form suitable for inspection, review, and copying by the agency

controls.title: Records not protected to enable their accurate and ready retrieval throughout the records retention period

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Records not protected to enable their accurate and ready retrieval throughout the records retention period

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Records not regularly backed up with tested restoration, so ready retrieval throughout the retention period is not shown (supporting check)

controls.title: System access not limited to authorized individuals

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System access not limited to authorized individuals

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Unique user IDs not enforced, so access cannot be shown to be limited to authorized individuals (supporting check)

controls.title: Audit trails are not computer-generated

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Audit trails are not computer-generated

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit trail entries are not accurately time-stamped

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit trail does not independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify, or delete electronic records

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit trail is not secure: users can modify or delete its entries

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Record changes obscure previously recorded information

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Audit trail documentation not retained at least as long as the subject electronic records, or not available for agency review and copying

controls.title: Operational system checks not used to enforce permitted sequencing of steps and events, as appropriate

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Operational system checks not used to enforce permitted sequencing of steps and events, as appropriate

controls.title: Authority checks not used to ensure that only authorized individuals can use the system, sign a record, access devices, alter a record, or perform the operation at hand

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Authority checks not used to ensure that only authorized individuals can use the system, sign a record, access devices, alter a record, or perform the operation at hand

controls.title: Device (e.g., terminal) checks not used to determine, as appropriate, the validity of the source of data input or operational instruction

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Device (e.g., terminal) checks not used to determine, as appropriate, the validity of the source of data input or operational instruction

controls.title: No determination that persons who develop, maintain, or use the system have the education, training, and experience to perform their assigned tasks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No determination that persons who develop, maintain, or use the system have the education, training, and experience to perform their assigned tasks

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Training records that evidence the education, training, and experience determination are not maintained (supporting check)

controls.title: Written policies that hold individuals accountable and responsible for actions initiated under their electronic signatures are not established and adhered to

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Written policies that hold individuals accountable and responsible for actions initiated under their electronic signatures are not established and adhered to

controls.title: No adequate controls over the distribution of, access to, and use of documentation for system operation and maintenance

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No adequate controls over the distribution of, access to, and use of documentation for system operation and maintenance

controls.title: No revision and change control procedures that maintain an audit trail of time-sequenced development and modification of systems documentation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No revision and change control procedures that maintain an audit trail of time-sequenced development and modification of systems documentation

controls.title: evidence missing or invalid: open_systems.in_use must be the boolean true or false (open system: 11.3(b)(9)); the open-system controls apply until it is false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: evidence missing or invalid: open_systems.in_use must be the boolean true or false (open system: 11.3(b)(9)); the open-system controls apply until it is false

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Open system does not use additional measures such as document encryption to ensure record authenticity, integrity, and confidentiality from creation to receipt

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Open system does not use appropriate digital signature standards (or an equivalent measure) to ensure record authenticity and integrity

controls.title: Signed electronic records do not contain the printed name of the signer

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Signed electronic records do not contain the printed name of the signer

controls.title: Signed electronic records do not contain the date and time when the signature was executed

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Signed electronic records do not contain the date and time when the signature was executed

controls.title: Signed electronic records do not contain the meaning (such as review, approval, responsibility, or authorship) associated with the signature

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Signed electronic records do not contain the meaning (such as review, approval, responsibility, or authorship) associated with the signature

controls.title: Signer name, date and time, and meaning are not included in every human readable form of the electronic record (display or printout)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Signer name, date and time, and meaning are not included in every human readable form of the electronic record (display or printout)

controls.title: Signatures are not linked to their respective electronic records

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Signatures are not linked to their respective electronic records

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Signatures can be excised, copied, or otherwise transferred to falsify an electronic record by ordinary means

controls.title: Electronic signatures are not unique to one individual, or are reused by or reassigned to someone else

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Electronic signatures are not unique to one individual, or are reused by or reassigned to someone else

controls.title: Identity of the individual not verified before the electronic signature is established, assigned, certified, or otherwise sanctioned

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Identity of the individual not verified before the electronic signature is established, assigned, certified, or otherwise sanctioned

controls.title: No certification to the agency that the electronic signatures are intended to be the legally binding equivalent of traditional handwritten signatures

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No certification to the agency that the electronic signatures are intended to be the legally binding equivalent of traditional handwritten signatures

controls.title: evidence missing or invalid: electronic_signatures.non_biometric.in_use must be true or false; the 11.200(a) controls apply until it is false and biometric.in_use is true

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: evidence missing or invalid: electronic_signatures.non_biometric.in_use must be true or false; the 11.200(a) controls apply until it is false and biometric.in_use is true

controls.title: Non-biometric electronic signatures do not employ at least two distinct identification components such as an identification code and password

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Non-biometric electronic signatures do not employ at least two distinct identification components such as an identification code and password

controls.title: In a series of signings in one continuous period of controlled access, the first does not use all components or a later one uses none executable only by the signer

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: In a series of signings in one continuous period of controlled access, the first does not use all components or a later one uses none executable only by the signer

controls.title: Signings not performed during one continuous period of controlled system access are not each executed using all of the electronic signature components

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Signings not performed during one continuous period of controlled system access are not each executed using all of the electronic signature components

controls.title: Non-biometric electronic signatures are not shown to be used only by their genuine owners

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Non-biometric electronic signatures are not shown to be used only by their genuine owners

controls.title: Non-biometric electronic signatures are not administered so that use by anyone other than the genuine owner requires collaboration of two or more individuals

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Non-biometric electronic signatures are not administered so that use by anyone other than the genuine owner requires collaboration of two or more individuals

controls.title: evidence missing or invalid: electronic_signatures.biometric.in_use must be true or false (biometrics: 11.3(b)(3)); the control applies until it is false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: evidence missing or invalid: electronic_signatures.biometric.in_use must be true or false (biometrics: 11.3(b)(3)); the control applies until it is false

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Biometric electronic signatures are not designed to ensure that they cannot be used by anyone other than their genuine owners

controls.title: evidence missing or invalid: identification_codes.in_use must be true or false (signatures based on identification codes with passwords); the controls apply until it is false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: evidence missing or invalid: identification_codes.in_use must be true or false (signatures based on identification codes with passwords); the controls apply until it is false

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: evidence missing or invalid: identification_codes.devices.in_use must be true or false (tokens, cards, other code or password devices); (c) and (e) apply until it is false

controls.title: Uniqueness of each combined identification code and password is not maintained

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Uniqueness of each combined identification code and password is not maintained

controls.title: Identification code and password issuances are not periodically checked, recalled, or revised (e.g., password aging)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Identification code and password issuances are not periodically checked, recalled, or revised (e.g., password aging)

controls.title: No loss management procedures to electronically deauthorize lost, stolen, missing, or potentially compromised tokens, cards, and other devices and to issue replacements

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No loss management procedures to electronically deauthorize lost, stolen, missing, or potentially compromised tokens, cards, and other devices and to issue replacements

controls.title: Transaction safeguards not used to prevent unauthorized use of passwords and/or identification codes

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Transaction safeguards not used to prevent unauthorized use of passwords and/or identification codes

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Attempts at unauthorized use of passwords or identification codes are not detected and reported in an immediate and urgent manner to the system security unit

controls.title: No initial and periodic testing of devices, such as tokens or cards, that bear or generate identification code or password information

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No initial and periodic testing of devices, such as tokens or cards, that bear or generate identification code or password information
